series.summary: Having conquered the swamp, Gon claims Ging's fishing rod from Aunt Mito. Mito confesses that his father chose the Hunter's life over raising him, expecting tears, but Gon is inspired to discover what makes hunting so magnificent. Promising to return as the greatest Hunter in the world, Gon boards the passenger ship and sets sail toward the open ocean.

segments.voiceover_text: A promised reward uncovers a painful family secret. Aunt Mito surrenders Ging's fishing rod, unable to hide her bitter grief.
She confesses the truth: Ging abandoned his only son because being a Hunter mattered more than family. She expects tears, but Gon is electrified.
Gon clutches the rod with fierce resolve. He must discover what made hunting worth abandoning a child. He vows to become the greatest Hunter alive.
The great vessel departs Whale Island. Gon waves goodbye to cheering villagers, oblivious to the ferocious tempest waiting to swallow his ship whole.
